offers.title: InfinityFree free web hosting
offers.php: PHP 8.4 (official homepage; second-hand reviews from August–September 2026 (8–9) state PHP 8.3)
offers.cardNote: No credit card required; email signup, no waitlist, no approval process.
offers.idlePolicy: 30 days with fewer than 5 hits leads to suspension, reactivatable in the client area; suspended accounts are deleted automatically after 20–60 days.
offers.panel: Not named on the official homepage — check the official page.
offers.specText: 5 GB disk space; Unlimited bandwidth; 400 MySQL databases; PHP 8.4; free SSL certificate; free subdomain with 25+ suffixes or bring a domain; free DNS service; full .htaccess support
offers.durationText: Free forever, not a trial, no expiry date
offers.regions: Server location not stated on the official homepage — check the official page.
risks: 50,000 hits/day cap: over the cap, the account goes offline for 24 hours, then recovers automatically; the free-tier quota cannot be raised on request
30 days with fewer than 5 hits counts as idle and leads to suspension; suspended accounts are deleted automatically after 20–60 days
CPU figures, email accounts, cron, and SSH are not stated on the official pages read — check the official page
offers.steps: Register with an email address on the InfinityFree official site → Create an account and pick a free subdomain (or add an owned domain later) → Upload files, or install WordPress with Softaculous, or build with the Site.pro builder → Enable free SSL.
offers.sourceName: InfinityFree official homepage · official forum KB
offers.notes: The panel type is not named on the official homepage. Second-hand claims about email/cron/CPU/SSH (no email accounts; cron disabled since 2023-08-09; CPU figures kept confidential) are unconfirmed on the official pages read.

offers.title: Byet.host free web hosting
offers.bandwidth: Unlimited (the official site states no hidden traffic caps)
offers.ssl: Free subdomains come with SSL automatically; owned domains install free SSL in the panel
offers.cardNote: No credit card, no trial; instant signup, no manual approval.
offers.idlePolicy: The TOS has only general terms, with no specific day count: it reserves the right to log out long-idle accounts, and long-idle accounts may be terminated without notice.
offers.specText: 5 GB NVMe disk; Unlimited bandwidth; unlimited MySQL databases; PHP 8.3; VistaPanel; free subdomain with 24 suffixes; unlimited addon/parked/subdomains; single file max 10 MB
risks: The hits/day cap has no number anywhere in the TOS — check the official page; the InfinityFree 50,000 hits figure must not be applied to Byet
No specific idle day count is stated; the TOS reserves the right to terminate long-idle accounts without notice
Max 3 free accounts per person; all accounts over the limit are terminated without notice
Backups are the customer’s responsibility; having a backup created on request costs $9.99 (waivable at discretion)
Excessive resource use may lead to suspension without notice
offers.steps: Register on the Byet.host free page (instant activation, no manual approval) → Pick a free subdomain or add an owned domain → Create databases in VistaPanel and install apps with Softaculous → For an owned domain, install free SSL in the panel.

Cron availability claims conflict: the Byet free page advertises cron-related features, while InfinityFree states a platform-level cron ban.
